purpose: Registration #3785 / release #3072 / incident #4445: independently attest the currently served production SSH public host key after two bounded exact-main release attempts failed closed on the existing pinned fingerprint, without changing the trust anchor or production state.
requiredBehavior: run the local attestation only on the pre-existing self-hosted production runner labels self-hosted, linux, x64, pc-prod and tai-readonly
verify the local runner is non-root and is not a member of the docker group
read only regular non-symlink root-owned public /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*_key.pub files and compute SHA-256 public fingerprints
scan only the canonical REG.RU production IPv4 address on the protected production SSH port from a hosted runner
require every externally observed public host-key fingerprint to be present in the independently attested local public-key set
compare the externally observed public key set against the existing protected PC_PROD_SSH_HOST_FINGERPRINT without publishing that protected value
bind both channels to one exact current main SHA and recheck current main after evidence collection
publish only public algorithm/fingerprint evidence plus coarse PASS/BLOCK classes
forbiddenCapabilities: changing or deleting PC_PROD_SSH_HOST_FINGERPRINT or any GitHub secret
StrictHostKeyChecking=no, accept-new, UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null, password SSH or any authenticated SSH session
reading any SSH private host key or production private key
sudo, Docker, systemctl mutation, service restart, deployment, migration or filesystem mutation on production
database, customer-data, password-reset, email-send, MFA, TOTP, session, role, tenant or reviewer mutation
new paid provider, SaaS subscription or recurring cost
unrelated PC-CROP business-flow, Gekta, Company OS or showroom behavior changes
acceptanceEvidence: pull-request contract proves exact two-path scope and rejects trust-bypass or production-mutation capabilities
self-hosted channel emits a bounded canonical set of public SSH host-key algorithms and SHA-256 fingerprints from root-owned public key files
hosted channel proves canonical DNS contains the fixed REG.RU VPS IPv4 and independently observes a non-empty external SSH host-key set
hosted channel proves every externally offered public host key exists in the self-hosted local attestation and classifies whether the existing protected pin is still offered
result explicitly states PRODUCTION_MUTATION=NONE and does not count as registration acceptance
